classification: short model-backed serial inference smoke of a locally built image; not a performance benchmark or parity test

source.dockerfile: docker/gfx906/Dockerfile (added in the commit that adds this receipt; the engine sources are those of the source commit)

image.engine_build: STRATA_HIP_GFX906=ON, CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx906, STRATA_PORTABLE=ON, Release, no extra HIP flags

build_checks.imports: serve.server, serve.prometheus, textual, torch 2.9.1+cpu, transformers, safetensors

environment.hardware_class: one AMD Instinct MI50 32 GB, gfx906; the host also has an integrated wave32 Radeon
environment.model_assets: external Swift Qwen3.8 Flash-Next IQ3_S assets with a pack and MTP files built by the v0.1.41 tools; not distributed
environment.config: the operator's production server config, unchanged except lib_dirs: --max-context 155648, --kv int8, --spec 4 with the MTP draft layer, --batch-mtp (reported off: no --batch), --vision with the CPU picture reader, conversation cache 3072 MiB / 4 slots

runs.name: all GPUs visible
runs.result: engine refused to start (exit 2): it saw the integrated wave32 GPU beside the MI50 (upstream #1728) and asked for HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES

requests.input: generated 128x128 PNG, left half red, right half blue

result.gpu_vision_reader: built and its libraries resolve; not exercised (the config selects the CPU reader)
result.prep_service_tools: present and --help runs; a full pack or MTP preparation was not run

limitations: Three short greedy requests on one card; sustained throughput, long contexts near 155K, batch slots and two-card splits were not exercised.

Outputs differ slightly from the native, non-portable build's smoke (130 vs 126 tokens on the first request) with a different expert-cache size; the engine notes that GPU-cached experts round differently from CPU ones. This is not a parity comparison.
The engine reported 586 MiB of VRAM free with everything loaded; a larger --vram-reserve-mib is advised for long runs.
The image was built and run locally and was not published or pulled from a registry.
